# Drop Cowboy

> The Communication Platform Built Around Ringless Voicemail. One REST API at https://api-v2.dropcowboy.com for ringless voicemail, texts, voice calls, email, AI voice agents and embeddable Building Blocks. Authenticate with the x-key and x-secret headers. Sends answer 202 (queued); results arrive on signed webhooks and callback_url. There is no npm SDK for this API.

## Start here

- [README](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/README.md): send a first ringless voicemail in five minutes
- [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/AGENTS.md): the facts a coding agent needs
- [Vibe coding](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/docs/vibe-coding.md): MCP setup and prompts
- [Troubleshooting](https://github.com/Drop-Cowboy/dropcowboy/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.md): start from the symptom
